title: The long stairs
goals: Do it in fewer than 4 lines.
starting_code:
# This code works in sixteen lines. Make it shorter with a loop.
wizard.move_up()
wizard.move_right()
wizard.move_up()
wizard.move_right()
wizard.move_up()
wizard.move_right()
wizard.move_up()
wizard.move_right()
wizard.move_up()
wizard.move_right()
wizard.move_up()
wizard.move_right()
wizard.move_up()
wizard.move_right()
wizard.move_up()
wizard.move_right()
hints: The code repeats `wizard.move_up()` and `wizard.move_right()` eight times.
Delete the extra lines, and repeat the two moves eight times with `for`.
Move the two actions under the loop. Move them in by four spaces.
intro: These stairs are very long. I wrote all the steps. Writing so much is tiring.
outro: That is much better. A loop saves us a lot of work.
learned: Now you know how to repeat things with a `for` repeat, which programmers call a loop.
